## Summary

I investigated ticket T-2009 and found that both pricing-engine pods in the pricing namespace are stuck in CrashLoopBackOff. Analysis of the pod logs revealed the root cause: **an off-by-one indexing error in the pricing-engine code when compiling the rule `BF-2026-STACKED`** with 3 tiers and stacking enabled. The error occurs in the `TierTable.Lookup` function trying to access index 3 on an array of length 3.

Since the code hasn't been deployed since April but a new crash is happening due to a pricing rule change, this requires investigation by an engineer to determine whether to fix the bad rule data in rules-admin or fix the code's handling of tier stacking. I've escalated the ticket for a human engineer to investigate and apply the appropriate fix.
